decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 3rd January 2007, the erection of a single storey side and rear extension and the installation of three windows on the front elevation of the house, giving a total volume increase to the original house of 95.78m3, as shown on drawing numbers 01 A and 02 C, received 3rd January 2007, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed erection of a single storey side and rear extension and the installation of three windows on the front elevation of the house, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
Condition : 2 - Informative:
If any part of this development is outside the curtilage of the dwellinghouse, the development will no longer be lawful and planning permission will be required.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a single storey side and rear extension with 3 windows installed on front elevation of house.
